hero.lede: Construyo de punta a punta con TypeScript, React, Node y PostgreSQL, con base profunda previa en PHP/Laravel y C#/ASP.NET. Mi trabajo con IA es orquestación e integración: definir herramientas, invocarlas desde un LLM, diseñar prompts, manejar permisos y caminos de falla. No entrenamiento de modelos ni MLOps.

meta.homeTitle: Jose Gerardo Martínez Morán — Software engineer
meta.homeDescription: Software engineer with nine years of production experience. End-to-end web systems in TypeScript, React, Node and PostgreSQL, plus language-model orchestration in real systems.

hero.headline: Nine years shipping web systems to production. Now with a language model at the wheel.
hero.lede: I build end to end with TypeScript, React, Node and PostgreSQL, on top of a long earlier base in PHP/Laravel and C#/ASP.NET. My AI work is orchestration and integration: defining tools, invoking them from an LLM, designing prompts, handling permissions and failure paths. No model training, no MLOps.
